# T-1: Add target status guards

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Complete CLI-side target comparison for Issue, spec, and runId targets. The command must return ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH before any mutating flow action can be selected.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Issue mismatch returns ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH with expectedIssue and activeIssue.
- Spec mismatch against current execution context returns ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH with expectedSpec and activeSpec.
- RunId mismatch against current execution context returns ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH with expectedRunId and activeRunId.
- Positional runId status remains a display lookup and is not used as dispatcher authorization.
- Active worktree-mode runId lookup resolves flow.json through active-flow registry/worktree state.
- Target match preserves current status envelope fields.

## Implementation Notes
Reuse get-status and FlowManager resolution. Keep default current-context status behavior unchanged when no explicit expected target is provided. Treat --expect-* options as current-context assertions; keep positional runId as display-only. Ensure resolveByRunId can load active worktree flow state.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests with `// spec: R<N>` headers for get-status target mismatch, target match, current-context status, positional runId status lookup, worktree-mode runId lookup, and expectation checks against current context. Shared unit tests may be updated only as supplemental contract coverage.
